platform_logic_unchanged: pixel node outside numeric call sites and depth boundary checks
fusion node including exact two-source-time TF and worker/epoch

intentional_boundary_enhancements: Reject empty/short/non-float-stride depth views and non-finite/unrepresentable bbox edges before arithmetic/casts in the pure C++ core.
Read float32 values via memcpy to support unaligned views.
Pixel adapter rejects unsupported host endianness and dimensions outside int representation.
retained_platform_contracts: Lidar camera uses lookup_transform_full with image/cloud source times and fixed odom; no latest fallback.
Pixel node retains its pre-existing latest TF fallback; camera/frame/time admission is not migrated or comprehensively redesigned.
Classification header/geometry/target admission, independent obstacle copies, observed_at/TTL/reasons and original geometry/occupancy/flight inputs stay in the functional layer.
limitations: Uses existing ROS/main/scene/ALG-2 underlays; not a clean full-workspace build.
Synthetic camera/cloud/clock/TF and tracking feedback software regressions; no actual flight or sensor accuracy certification.
Relocation covers CMake exports and explicitly installed Python module paths, not all generated colcon shell environment scripts.
Pinhole calculation retains the old aligned-depth/no-undistortion assumption and caller-owned valid intrinsics.
ALG0-B02/B03 and historical semantic shutdown issue remain unresolved; shutdown/stress tests were not rerun.
